title: This is great!
text: This is great!. This is a very attractive and useful paper towel holder.  I really like how it keeps the roll from unraveling when I only want one towel.  The size is great also, because it fits the large rolls of paper towels from Costco.  I'm trying to think who I can give one to as a gift some time.

product_metadata.title: Kamenstein Bamboo Perfect Tear Paper Towel Holder
features: Patented Perfect Tear technology ensures absolutely no unraveling from the roll
Simple one-hand operation; just pull and tear with perfect results
Paper towel roll simply slides on and off holder; no need to remove end cap
description: The Kamnestein Perfect Tear Paper Towel Holder has Patented Perfect Tear technology which ensures absolutely no unraveling from the roll, simple one-hand operation. Simply pull and tear to get perfect results.
